app.title: Show HN: News Blocklist – a DNS blocklist of 14k news and current-affairs sites
app.description: A DNS-based blocklist for news and current‑affairs sites, usable with DNS filtering tools
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the provided install script
Generate a zone file and verify that known news domains resolve to NXDOMAIN
Load the blocklist into a local DNS server and query a sample domain
Measure lookup performance with a batch of 1000 queries
